capacityAndOriginalMeasurements.currentFormat2Control: exact owned copies of actual baseline history; 15 real timed distinct Save calls, not a sequential-capacity claim
capacityAndOriginalMeasurements.protocol: warm Load on original/control roots; Save/Restore on owned clones; 3 ABC/CBA/ABC rounds; identical generated inputs; copies/Decode outside timers; all latency instrumentation disabled
capacityAndOriginalMeasurements.scope: format2 before/after same protocol; format2/3 workload comparison; logical metrics, not physical device I/O

finalReview.protocol: 7 paired groups at 1024, one control group at 32/128/256/512; rotated variant/operation/condition order; fresh owned clones for all operations; copy and optional verified Load warmup outside timer; same-operation profiles only for current binaries
finalReview.limitations: instrumented and uninstrumented conditions separate; baseline has no fine profiler, null is unavailable rather than zero; warm Load is not a disk-cache flush or host-quiescence proof; logical reads not device IO; small-sample percentiles not stable tail guarantees
